# Natural Satellite

Natural Satellite is the little unicorn modeled after Chibiusa Tsukino (Sailor Chibi Moon) from Sailor Moon. She is a G4 background character, not literally Chibiusa transported into Equestria. Her comic design has a pale cream-gold coat, pink mane styled in distinctive pointed twin buns, raspberry eyes and a crescent moon inside a heart as her cutie mark. Her television cameo uses muted gray-blue and mauve colors; the mark is not confirmed on screen. [Show/comic design comparison, with reference images](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Forum:PonyComparison#Sailor_Moon_ponies).

- **Name and personality:** Originally a fandom/wiki placeholder, Natural Satellite is now also her licensed Gameloft mobile-game name, introduced in [update 10.5](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Update_10.5) in September 2025. The name is a play on the Moon. The game describes her as the youngest of the group but a formidable personality. She remains unnamed in the television series. [Sailor Moon ponies character overview](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sailor_Moon_ponies).
- **Speaking status:** No verified solo dialogue or voice actor. No separate pony alter ego is established.
- **Creation:** Amy Mebberson drew and colored the Celestia micro-series comic, as discussed in her [2014 creator interview](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2014/11/equestria-daily-interview-series.html?hl=en).

## Important moments

Her known appearances are cameos rather than character-defining decisions; these are the two identifiable story appearances.

- **Royal High Tea — [Micro-Series #8: Celestia](https://www.g-mart.com/static/f123234.html)** (September 11, 2013), page 7. She appears alongside Saturnalia at the School for Gifted Unicorns, introducing the Chibi Moon homage in licensed IDW comics.
- **Friendship finale — [The Cutie Re-Mark – Part 2](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-cutie-re-mark-part-2/umc.cmc.3cc40orsk2bxbfmtmvbnzeo05)** (S5E26, November 28, 2015). She appears during the closing song, Friends Are Always There For You, alongside other Sailor Moon-inspired ponies. Timestamp unavailable.

The reference images are indexed in the linked design comparison, but the individual image assets could not be independently loaded; no unverified embed or fan-art attribution is included. The exact originator of the placeholder name was not established.
